content_html:
watched #CHHICHHORE : Man!!!! what a movie….I am not exaggerating, but this movie has in it to make it to the list of the likes of #DilChahtaHai #3Idiots & #ZindagiNaMilegiDobara

The film actually made in terms of the above 3 mentioned above but it stands out in its own unique way in the emotinal message it delivers & the realistic way the collage life & chars are protrayed…..We always can find a “Anni” “Sexa” “Acid” “Mummy” & “Bevda” in our group of friends

Director Nitesh Tiwari and his group of writers did a fantastic job with the story, dialogues and screen play by mixing emotion, sentiment and comedy in perfect proportions……..The Screenplay of the movie stands out and is outstanding!!!! thus leaving audience with a feel of watching an Emotional Comedy movie with Sentiment!!!!!

in one word……the film dialogue “its not your result that decides if you are successful or a failure…..but its ur effort that decides it!!!!” sums up the whole movie

but in my view….the Chhichhore team not only succeded in their efforts but also with the results _/\_
